title: The Poison That Came Before the Nectar | Samudra Manthan

lines.text: Even the gods can lose all their power. This is how they got it back.
lines.caps: Even the *gods | can lose *all their power. | This is how they got it *back.

lines.text: A sage's curse drained the gods of their strength, and the demons took over the heavens.
lines.caps: A sage's *curse | drained their *strength. | The *demons took the heavens.

lines.text: Vishnu told them: make peace with the demons for now, and churn the ocean of milk. It will give you amrita, the nectar of immortality.
lines.caps: *Churn the ocean. | It will give you *amrita, | the nectar of *immortality.

lines.text: Mount Mandara became the churning rod, and the serpent Vasuki became the rope. The gods held the tail. The demons held the head.
lines.caps: *Mount Mandara | became the *rod. | The serpent *Vasuki | became the *rope.

lines.text: But the mountain began to sink. So Vishnu became a giant tortoise and held it on his back.
lines.caps: The mountain began to *sink. | Vishnu became a *giant tortoise.

lines.text: The churning shook the whole ocean. And the first thing to rise was a terrible poison.
lines.caps: The ocean *shook. | The first thing to rise | was a terrible *poison.

lines.text: Everyone ran in fear. Shiva drank the poison and held it in his throat, which turned blue.
lines.caps: Everyone *ran. | *Shiva drank the poison. | His throat turned *blue.

lines.text: The churning went on. Wonders rose from the waves: a divine cow, a white elephant, a horse, and the goddess Lakshmi, who chose Vishnu.
At last Dhanvantari appeared, holding a pot of amrita.
The demons grabbed it. But Vishnu, as the enchantress Mohini, tricked them, and the gods drank the nectar.
lines.caps: The demons *grabbed it. | *Mohini tricked them. | The gods *drank.

lines.text: Patience and teamwork turned a curse into victory. Follow for more stories.
lines.caps: *Patience and teamwork | turned a *curse | into *victory. | Follow for *more stories.
